subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should every embedded fallback turn triggered by a completion announcement lose `sessions_spawn`, or must legitimate unrelated and remaining-task delegation stay available?
rationale: The incident supports preventing duplicate execution, but the current boolean gate implements the stronger compatibility-breaking policy and source cannot infer that product choice safely.

options.title: Preserve legitimate delegation
options.body: Narrow or remove the blanket denial so unrelated remaining work can still spawn, with focused positive and negative behavior proof.

options.title: Approve turn-wide denial
options.body: Explicitly accept that all embedded spawning is unavailable on fallback completion-announcement turns and document the recovery limitation.

options.title: Defer mechanical enforcement
options.body: Land only the completion-evidence instruction hardening while a shared cross-surface delegation policy is designed.

recommendation.title: Preserve legitimate delegation
recommendation.body: Narrow or remove the blanket denial so unrelated remaining work can still spawn, with focused positive and negative behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the cross-harness review and has merged history in both fallback and ACP spawn behavior.
